 Home Entertainment QUICK TAKE | Marvel's 25-Year Journey Leads to Avengers: Doomsday: Seven Things to Know QUICK TAKE | Marvel's 25-Year Journey Leads to Avengers: Doomsday: Seven Things to Know
 Open Bureau Last Updated: November 16, 2026, 13:21 IST Summarise Share Share More than 25 years after the original X-Men film introduced Marvel’s mutants to the big screen, familiar characters from that franchise are set to join the Avengers universe. Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige says the crossover is a fitting way to mark a quarter-century of storytelling. Feige, who was an associate producer on the 2000 X-Men film, told Empire that bringing the original X-Men and the Avengers together felt like the right way to culminate 25 years of storytelling.   Credits: ANI 1. Why is Kevin Feige calling this a milestone? 
 Feige, who was an associate producer on the 2000 X-Men film, told Empire that bringing the original X-Men and the Avengers together felt like the right way to culminate 25 years of storytelling. He recalled Hugh Jackman speaking years ago about the possibility of the two teams appearing together on screen.

 Several actors from the earlier X-Men films are reprising their roles in Avengers: Doomsday . The returning cast includes Patrick Stewart as Professor X, Ian McKellen as Magneto, James Marsden as Cyclops, Rebecca Romijn as Mystique, Alan Cumming as Nightcrawler and Kelsey Grammer as Beast. 
 3. How did the Avengers and X-Men crossover become possible? 
 The original X-Men film arrived in 2000, eight years before the Marvel Cinematic Universe began with Iron Man in 2008. The X-Men film rights were previously held by 20th Century Fox. Disney’s acquisition of 21st Century Fox in 2019 brought the franchise under the same corporate umbrella as Marvel Studios, opening the way for the characters to be brought together on screen.

 Both actors have been listed among the contributors to Doomsday 's additional literary material, alongside eight other writers. The film's main screenplay credits go to Stephen McFeely and Michael Waldron. The additional credits have prompted speculation about Jackman and Reynolds' involvement, but they do not, by themselves, confirm that Wolverine or Deadpool will appear in the film.

Why is Patrick Stewart's return significant? 
 Stewart will reprise Professor Charles Xavier in what Marvel Studios has confirmed will be his final on-screen appearance. He first played the character in the 2000 X-Men film and portrayed the telepathic mutant across multiple films over more than two decades. 
 6. What is known about the film's story and cast? 
 Marvel describes Avengers: Doomsday as a story in which heroes from three distinct universes are brought into conflict against an existential threat. The announced ensemble also includes Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Pedro Pascal, Paul Rudd, Anthony Mackie, Florence Pugh, Tom Hiddleston and Simu Liu, among others. 
 7. When will Avengers: Doomsday release? 
 The film is scheduled to arrive in theatres on December 18, 2026. It is directed by Anthony and Joe Russo and produced by Kevin Feige, Louis D'Esposito and Jonathan Schwartz.
